reference.text: “Now, Anne, I noticed last night that you threw your clothes all about the floor when you took them off.

underlines.text: was so harrowed up in my mind last night that I didn’t think about my clothes at all

reference.text: You couldn’t quite call it poetry, I suppose, but it sounds a lot like it, doesn’t it?”

underlines.text: We’re not talking about poetry, Anne

reference.text: “Just thank God for your blessings and ask Him humbly for the things you want.”

underlines.text: that’s all the blessings I can think of just now to thank Thee for
